label: Vite
hint: plain Vite + Vitest, ESLint and Prettier

steering.content:
## Toolchain: Vite

- `{{pmRun}} dev`: Vite dev server.
- `{{pmRun}} build`: type-check, then `vite build`.
- `{{pmRun}} lint`: ESLint (flat config in `eslint.config.js`) and `tsc --noEmit`.
- `{{pmRun}} test`: Vitest, once (`vitest run`).
- `{{pmRun}} format`: Prettier.
- Build and test config share `vite.config.ts` (`defineConfig` from `vitest/config`); there is no separate `vitest.config.ts`.

## Library build (Vite)

- `{{pmRun}} build`: type-check, then `vite build` in library mode (`build.lib` in `vite.config.ts`) → `dist/index.js` (ESM) + `dist/index.d.ts` from `vite-plugin-dts`. Peers listed in `package.json` are external.
- There is no dev server for the library itself; develop components in Storybook.
